items.title: BaseFilterable
items.description: An object used to allow specifying flexible queries with and/or conditions.

items.title: OptionsQuery
items.description: The options to apply when retrieving an item.

items.title: FindOptions
items.description: An object used to specify filters and options on a list of items.

items.title: UpsertWithReplaceConfig
items.description: An object used to specify the configuration of how the upsert should be performed.

items.title: RepositoryService
items.description:
Data access layer (DAL) interface to implements for any repository service.
This layer helps to separate the business logic (service layer) from accessing the
ORM directly and allows to switch to another ORM without changing the business logic.

items.title: TreeRepositoryService
items.description:
Data access layer (DAL) interface to implements for any repository service.
This layer helps to separate the business logic (service layer) from accessing the
ORM directly and allows to switch to another ORM without changing the business logic.

items.title: SoftDeleteReturn
items.description: An object that is used to specify an entity's related entities that should be soft-deleted when the main entity is soft-deleted.

items.title: RestoreReturn
items.description: An object that is used to specify an entity's related entities that should be restored when the main entity is restored.

items.title: InferRepositoryReturnType
items.description: Either infer the properties from a DML object or from a Mikro orm class prototype.
